notes: The person's key, made on this device, its private key sealed for this device (share-e2ee-v1/person, person:<user id>). Once per person: 409 key_exists when they have one, unless start_over: then everything sealed for the old one goes (their folder keys, their other devices' copies, the password lock), and they wait for others to seal again. 409 no_key without this device's key (PUT /api/keys/device first).
